statement: Grid interconnection is a queue rather than a price.
test: Compare queue position against energization date across the panel.
kill: Projects buy their way forward and energization order stops matching queue order.
blast_radius: the whole power chain and every provider spread read

statement: Heavy equipment lead times are capacity gates rather than price signals.
test: Compare order books against delivered units and price realisations.
kill: Prices clear the backlog and lead times fall while order books stay full.
blast_radius: equipment margin chains

statement: Data centre load is firm and does not curtail at system peaks.
test: Compare data centre load profiles against system peak events.
kill: Load curtails voluntarily or under contract at peaks.
blast_radius: capacity prices and provider siting

statement: Inference demand is elastic at current prices.
test: Compare unit price changes against usage changes at the same intervals.
kill: Usage is flat or falls when unit prices fall.
blast_radius: the whole compute demand curve

statement: Capacity spending lands in earnings before it lands in revenue.
test: Compare capex announcements against revenue and depreciation timelines.
kill: Revenue arrives with the capex or ahead of it.
blast_radius: the capex absorption chain and every provider multiple

statement: The largest tenants have a credible self build alternative.
test: Compare tenant contract terms against their own capacity announcements.
kill: Tenants sign long deals at posted prices with no own build programme.
blast_radius: provider pricing power and spreads

statement: A forced seller is finite and identifiable after the fact.
test: Compare open interest and funding signatures at dislocation events.
kill: Dislocations arrive with no identifiable forced side.
blast_radius: the cascade family and its cost hurdle

statement: The post flow reversal is larger than the round trip cost of taking it.
test: Compare gross reversion against fees and spreads at the same events.
kill: Reversion is smaller than costs at every level.
blast_radius: the whole cascade family

statement: Subsidised capital is less disciplined than equity funded capital.
test: Compare cancellation rates of subsidised against unsubsidised capacity.
kill: Subsidised projects cancel at lower rates.
blast_radius: the policy pull forward chain

statement: Water constraints bind locally before globally.
test: Compare local drought measures against project announcements by basin.
kill: Constraints appear as a global rule rather than site by site.
blast_radius: site selection and retrofit capex

statement: Transformer core steel is the binding input rather than labour.
test: Compare lead times against steel availability and mill expansions.
kill: Lead times shorten while steel stays tight or vice versa.
blast_radius: the equipment scarcity chain

statement: Every measured association can be an artifact of sample, timing or specification.
test: Re-run a finding on a disjoint sample and specification.
kill: A finding holds across samples, periods and specifications.
blast_radius: every mechanical claim in the repository

statement: The graph is the research object and the trade is a path through it.
test: Check that every trade claim names a path with a payer and a kill.
kill: Trades are proposed without a path or a kill.
blast_radius: how research is sequenced and reported

statement: The sign of the rental spread response to new supply depends on elasticity.
test: Compare new supply windows against rental price changes split by demand growth.
kill: Rental prices fall on new supply in every elasticity regime.
blast_radius: provider spreads and the capex absorption chain

statement: The punishment of capex intensity depends on the rate direction in the window.
test: Split the intensity panel by rate direction and compare the sign.
kill: Intensity is charged identically across rate directions.
blast_radius: the intensity object and its segment cuts

statement: Permitting reform only helps if permits were the binding clock.
test: Compare permit timelines against equipment lead times after reform.
kill: Lead times fall when permits fall.
blast_radius: the power chain and utility plans

statement: The self build threat from large tenants is live at every negotiation.
test: Compare announced tenant capacity against contract signings.
kill: Tenants sign long contracts while building nothing.
blast_radius: provider spreads, revenue per megawatt and the funding chain

statement: The cycle cannot be funded by public equity alone at this scale.
test: Compare issuance against the capital needed for announced capacity.
kill: Issuance covers the announced build.
blast_radius: financing chain and cycle sign map

statement: Efficiency gains are absorbed by new uses rather than reducing capacity demand.
test: Test the link force:demand:token-volume to force:demand:model-efficiency directly.
kill: Capacity demand falls in absolute terms while token volume rises.
blast_radius: More tokens can be served by better models, so efficiency substitutes for raw capacity.

statement: HBM capacity is the binding constraint on accelerator shipments.
test: Test the link force:demand:token-volume to force:silicon:hbm-supply directly.
kill: Accelerator shipments rise while HBM supply is flat.
blast_radius: More served tokens pull memory bits through the same fabs.

statement: Data centre load does not curtail at system peaks.
test: Test the link force:demand:token-volume to force:power:firm-capacity-scarcity directly.
kill: Firm capacity prices stay flat while data centre load grows.
blast_radius: Continuous inference load raises the peak and the floor of power demand at once.

statement: Efficiency gains are not immediately absorbed by new demand.
test: Test the link force:demand:model-efficiency to force:power:energization-delay directly.
kill: Efficiency improves and power demand for the same workload rises.
blast_radius: Cheaper tokens per wait soften the urgency of new connections.

statement: Silicon and power lead times are comparable and not substitutable.
test: Test the link force:silicon:accelerator-lead-time to force:power:energization-delay directly.
kill: Clusters energise with siloed silicon or idle powered sites without silicon.
blast_radius: A cluster needs silicon and power in the same window; the shorter of the two decides.

statement: ASIC programmes replace rather than complement merchant parts.
test: Test the link force:silicon:asic-substitution to force:silicon:accelerator-resale-value directly.
kill: Resale values hold while substitution scales.
blast_radius: In-house silicon reduces the future demand for merchant parts and their resale value.

statement: Queue positions are real and not reordered by policy.
test: Test the link force:power:interconnection-queue to force:power:energization-delay directly.
kill: Projects jump the queue without paying or a rule change.
blast_radius: Queue position is the clock on the project.

statement: The bottleneck is real rather than announced.
test: Test the link force:power:energization-delay to force:providers:rental-spread directly.
kill: Spreads narrow while energization delays lengthen.
blast_radius: Delay keeps installed capacity scarce and rental spreads wide.

statement: The transformer is a true gate rather than a schedulable input.
test: Test the link force:grid:transformer-lead-time to force:power:energization-delay directly.
kill: Sites energize without transformers or with substitutes.
blast_radius: No transformer means no energization, whatever the queue says.

statement: Utilities cannot substitute equipment or buy second hand at scale.
test: Test the link force:grid:transformer-lead-time to force:grid:utility-capex-plan directly.
kill: Plans accelerate while lead times lengthen.
blast_radius: Equipment scarcity forces plans to stretch and rephase.

statement: Utilities cannot fund indefinite working capital gaps.
test: Test the link force:grid:rate-case-lag to force:grid:utility-capex-plan directly.
kill: Plans accelerate while recovery lags.
blast_radius: A long lag to recovery makes utilities sequence spend carefully.

statement: Hardening is mandatory and cannot be deferred.
test: Test the link force:grid:wildfire-hardening to force:grid:utility-capex-plan directly.
kill: Growth capex accelerates while hardening spend rises.
blast_radius: Hardening spend uses the same equipment and crews as growth.

statement: Rental prices clear on availability.
test: Test the link force:grid:transformer-lead-time to force:providers:rental-spread directly.
kill: Spreads narrow while transformer delays run long.
blast_radius: Power delays keep the installed base scarce and spreads wide.

statement: Core steel cannot be imported at scale under current duties.
test: Test the link force:materials:goes-steel to force:grid:transformer-lead-time directly.
kill: Lead times fall while steel capacity is flat.
blast_radius: Core steel is the long pole in transformer output.

statement: Fuel supply is not substitutable inside the restart window.
test: Test the link force:materials:nuclear-fuel-enrichment to force:power:nuclear-ppa directly.
kill: Restarts proceed while fuel coverage is short.
blast_radius: Firm nuclear power needs fuel contracts that reach years ahead.

statement: Crews cannot be imported or trained inside the plan window.
test: Test the link force:labor:construction-crews to force:grid:utility-capex-plan directly.
kill: Plans execute faster than crew availability allows.
blast_radius: Plans are only as fast as the crews that build them.

statement: The trade cannot be substituted by equipment.
test: Test the link force:labor:electricians to force:power:energization-delay directly.
kill: Sites energize faster than electrician availability allows.
blast_radius: Energization work needs licensed electricians in a narrow window.

statement: Casting capacity cannot be expanded quickly.
test: Test the link force:labor:turbine-casters to force:power:gas-turbine-slot directly.
kill: Turbines ship at booked rates despite casting constraints.
blast_radius: Casting capacity decides how many turbine slots become machines.

statement: Local politics can delay but not permanently block.
test: Test the link force:sites:community-opposition to force:sites:land-permitting directly.
kill: Projects with active opposition proceed on schedule.
blast_radius: Organised opposition converts permits into litigation.

statement: Rights are not transferable at the needed scale.
test: Test the link force:sites:water-rights to force:water:cooling-water-availability directly.
kill: Sites with water constraints run evaporative cooling anyway.
blast_radius: The permit is what makes the water usable.

statement: Investors accept equipment and contract risk at the offered spread.
test: Test the link force:financing:abs-capacity to force:providers:neocloud-funding directly.
kill: Lessors fund only with equity and their growth stalls.
blast_radius: Securitisation lets lessors fund fleets against contracted cash flows.

statement: Vendor financing expands when demand softens, not when it surges.
test: Test the link force:financing:vendor-financing to force:silicon:accelerator-lead-time directly.
kill: Terms tighten while lead times lengthen.
blast_radius: Vendor credit terms are a read on end demand strength.

statement: Depreciation policy is not fully transparent to the market.
test: Test the link force:financing:depreciation-schedule to force:providers:equity-multiple directly.
kill: Multiples are unchanged by depreciation policy changes.
blast_radius: The schedule decides reported earnings for the same cash flow.

statement: Lenders mark and manage exposure actively.
test: Test the link force:financing:credit-spreads to force:cycles:price-collapse directly.
kill: Spread widening has no effect on asset sales.
blast_radius: Spread widening forces the marginal owner to sell into weakness.

statement: Merchant revenue is the entry signal.
test: Test the link force:policy:energy-price-caps to force:power:merchant-power-price directly.
kill: Entry continues while caps are binding.
blast_radius: Caps remove the scarcity signal that would attract generation.

statement: The market charges near term earnings rather than rewarding capacity.
test: Test the link force:providers:capex-intensity to force:providers:equity-multiple directly.
kill: Multiples rise with intensity, as the asset growth literature once implied.
blast_radius: Spending ahead of revenue compresses near term earnings and multiples.

statement: Concentration is durable rather than temporary.
test: Test the link force:providers:tenant-concentration to force:providers:rental-spread directly.
kill: Spreads widen while concentration rises.
blast_radius: A few large tenants set price and terms.

statement: Discipline survives competitive pressure.
test: Test the link force:providers:hyperscaler-roic-discipline to force:providers:capex-intensity directly.
kill: Intensity keeps rising through a stated discipline phase.
blast_radius: Discipline shows up as slower intensity growth.

statement: Builders cannot coordinate to stop at demand.
test: Test the link force:cycles:capital-inflow to force:cycles:capacity-overbuild directly.
kill: Capacity additions track demand without overshoot.
blast_radius: Funded capacity gets built, and it arrives in herds.

statement: Supply is price inelastic downward.
test: Test the link force:cycles:capacity-overbuild to force:cycles:price-collapse directly.
kill: Prices hold while utilisation falls.
blast_radius: Excess capacity clears at prices below full cost.

statement: Buyers have capital and conviction at the bottom.
test: Test the link force:cycles:price-collapse to force:cycles:shakeout-consolidation directly.
kill: Distress appears with no consolidation.
blast_radius: Distress transfers assets to the strongest balance sheets.

statement: The dislocation is larger than the cost of taking the other side.
test: Test the link force:micro:forced-deleveraging to force:micro:reversion-candidate directly.
kill: Dislocations continue without reversal.
blast_radius: Dislocations created by forced flow can revert once the flow ends.

statement: Elasticity does not absorb the efficiency gain inside the window.
test: Test the link force:demand:model-efficiency to force:providers:rental-spread directly.
kill: Spreads hold while efficiency improves sharply.
blast_radius: Cheaper tokens per watt reduce capacity per unit of output.

statement: Residuals are observable and enforceable.
test: Test the link force:silicon:accelerator-resale-value to force:providers:neocloud-funding directly.
kill: Funding terms are unchanged by residual values.
blast_radius: Lenders underwrite the fleet against residual value.

statement: Providers cannot pass the full move to tenants in the short run.
test: Test the link force:power:merchant-power-price to force:providers:revenue-per-mw directly.
kill: Revenue per megawatt is unchanged by power prices.
blast_radius: Power cost is a direct deduction from the revenue a megawatt can earn.

statement: Load forecasts are revised rather than sticky.
test: Test the link force:cycles:capacity-overbuild to force:grid:utility-capex-plan directly.
kill: Capex plans accelerate through an overbuild.
blast_radius: Excess capacity defers the next wave of grid spend.

statement: Distressed terms do not attract new capacity in the same window.
test: Test the link force:cycles:price-collapse to force:providers:neocloud-funding directly.
kill: Funding opens wider during a price collapse.
blast_radius: Funding closes when the price signal breaks.

statement: Rating agencies do not aggregate sector exposure fast enough.
test: Test the link force:financing:abs-capacity to force:cycles:capacity-overbuild directly.
kill: Issuance closes before the overbuild arrives.
blast_radius: Securitisation lets the marginal builder keep building past the point of sense.

statement: Demand persists past the delay window rather than moving to another site.
test: Test the link force:power:energization-delay to force:providers:capex-intensity directly.
kill: Providers keep spending into delays that outlast the demand.
blast_radius: When power is gated, the spend is only in the money if the delay is shorter than the demand curve.

statement: New supply serves elastic demand rather than displacing the installed base.
test: Test the link force:demand:inference-price-elasticity to force:providers:rental-spread directly.
kill: Prices collapse on new supply even with elastic demand.
blast_radius: Elasticity is the moderator that decides whether rental prices fall on new supply.

statement: Multiple compression dominates the capacity reward in the window.
test: Test the link force:financing:policy-rate to force:providers:capex-intensity directly.
kill: Intensity is rewarded in every rate regime.
blast_radius: Rate direction decides whether intensity is punished or ignored.
